# rintup_monitor (Resource)

An uptime monitor. Only `type` and the target in the block of that type are required; everything else has a server default that is read back into state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The smallest monitor: only the type and its target. Everything else (name, interval,
# locations, confirmations...) takes the server default and is read back into state.
resource "rintup_monitor" "home" {
  type = "http"
  http = { url = "https://www.example.com" }
}

# An HTTP check with secrets. headers_wo / basic_auth_password_wo are write-only: Terraform sends
# them but never stores them in state. Bump the *_version value to send a new secret.
variable "api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "rintup_monitor" "api" {
  type              = "http"
  name              = "Public API"
  interval_seconds  = 60
  locations         = ["fra", "ist"]
  contact_group_ids = [rintup_contact_group.ops.id]
  tags              = ["prod", "api"]

  http = {
    url             = "https://api.example.com/health"
    method          = "GET"
    keyword_present = "\"status\":\"ok\""
    expected_status = [{ from = 200, to = 299 }]

    headers_wo         = { Authorization = "Bearer ${var.api_token}" }
    headers_wo_version = "2026-10-30" # change when the token rotates
  }
}

resource "rintup_monitor" "db" {
  type = "tcp"
  tcp  = { host = "db.example.com", port = 5432 }
}

resource "rintup_monitor" "dns" {
  type = "dns"
  dns  = { host = "example.com", record_type = "MX", expected = ["mail.example.com"] }
}

resource "rintup_monitor" "ping" {
  type = "ping"
  ping = { host = "203.0.113.10", count = 3 }
}

resource "rintup_monitor" "cert" {
  type = "ssl"
  ssl  = { host = "example.com", thresholds_days = [30, 14, 7] }
}

resource "rintup_monitor" "domain" {
  type   = "domain"
  domain = { domain = "example.com", expected_nameservers = ["ns1.example.net", "ns2.example.net"] }
}

resource "rintup_monitor" "speed" {
  type      = "pagespeed"
  pagespeed = { url = "https://www.example.com", max_total_ms = 3000 }
}

# Heartbeat: your cron job calls push_url; no block needed.
resource "rintup_monitor" "backup_job" {
  type             = "push"
  interval_seconds = 86400
  push             = { grace_seconds = 600 }
}

output "backup_push_url" {
  value     = rintup_monitor.backup_job.push_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) One of `http`, `tcp`, `dns`, `ping`, `ssl`, `domain`, `pagespeed`, `push`. Changing it replaces the monitor.

### Optional

- `aggregate_rule` (String) How locations are combined: `majority`, `any` or `all`. Default: `majority`.
- `confirmations` (Number) Consecutive failed checks per location before it counts as down. Default: `2`.
- `contact_group_ids` (Set of String) Contact groups (`rintup_contact_group`) that receive alerts.
- `dns` (Attributes) DNS record check; required when `type = "dns"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns))
- `domain` (Attributes) Domain registration expiry and name servers; required when `type = "domain"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domain))
- `http` (Attributes) HTTP(S) check; required when `type = "http"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http))
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Check interval in seconds: 30, 60, 120, 300, 600, 900, 1800, 3600, 21600, 43200 or 86400. Default: 300 or the plan minimum (ssl >= 3600, domain >= 21600).
- `locations` (Set of String) Probe location codes (see the `rintup_locations` data source). Default: the first online locations allowed by the plan.
- `name` (String) Display name. Default: derived from the target (host or URL).
- `pagespeed` (Attributes) Page load time; required when `type = "pagespeed"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pagespeed))
- `paused` (Boolean) Pause checks (POST /monitors/{id}/pause and /resume). Default: `false`.
- `ping` (Attributes) ICMP ping; required when `type = "ping"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ping))
- `push` (Attributes) Heartbeat settings for `type = "push"` (optional; the server fills defaults). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--push))
- `repeat_every_minutes` (Number) Repeat the alert every N minutes while down; 0 = once. Default: `0`.
- `ssl` (Attributes) TLS certificate expiry; required when `type = "ssl"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ssl))
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags.
- `tcp` (Attributes) TCP port check; required when `type = "tcp"`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tcp))
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Timeout in milliseconds. Default: 10000 (domain 30000, pagespeed 60000).
- `trigger_delay_seconds` (Number) Wait this long while down before alerting. Default: `0`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Monitor id (UUID).
- `push_url` (String, Sensitive) Push (heartbeat) monitors: the path your job calls, relative to the API host. It contains the push token.
- `status` (String) Current status (`up`, `down`, `pending`...). Informational; it does not cause a diff.
- `target` (String) What is checked, as shown in the panel.

<a id="nestedatt--dns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns`

Required:

- `host` (String) Name to resolve.

Optional:

- `expected` (Set of String) Expected answers (any order). Empty: any answer.
- `record_type` (String) `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX`, `TXT` or `NS`. Default: `A`.
- `resolver` (String) Resolver IP. Default: the probe's resolver.


<a id="nestedatt--domain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domain`

Required:

- `domain` (String) Registered domain (e.g. `example.com`, not `www.example.com`: the server reduces names to the registered domain).

Optional:

- `expected_nameservers` (Set of String) Expected name servers (lowercase, no trailing dot). Empty: not checked.
- `thresholds_days` (Set of Number) Alert this many days before expiry. Default: the server's thresholds.


<a id="nestedatt--http"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http`

Required:

- `url` (String) http(s) address to check. When its scheme, host or port changes, stored secrets are not carried over: change `headers_wo_version`, `body_wo_version` and `basic_auth_password_wo_version` (for the ones set) in the same apply, or the update fails with RUP-MON-400-SECRETS_REENTRY_REQUIRED.

Optional:

- `basic_auth_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Basic authentication password. Write-only: never stored in state. Change `basic_auth_password_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `basic_auth_password_wo_version` (String) Any value (e.g. `1` or a date). When it changes, `basic_auth_password_wo` is sent again; when it is removed together with the secret, the stored secret is deleted.
- `basic_auth_user` (String) Basic authentication user name.
- `body_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Request body. Write-only: never stored in state. Change `body_wo_version` to send a new value.
- `body_wo_version` (String) Any value (e.g. `1` or a date). When it changes, `body_wo` is sent again; when it is removed together with the secret, the stored secret is deleted.
- `content_type` (String) Content-Type of the request body.
- `expected_status` (Attributes List) Accepted status ranges. Default: none (any 2xx). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http--expected_status))
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) Follow redirects. Default: `true`.
- `headers_wo` (Map of String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Request headers (all values are treated as secrets). Write-only: never stored in state. Change `headers_wo_version` to send the map again (it replaces all headers).
- `headers_wo_version` (String) Any value; when it changes `headers_wo` is sent again.
- `keyword_absent` (String) The response must not contain this text.
- `keyword_present` (String) The response must contain this text.
- `method` (String) `GET`, `HEAD`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH` or `DELETE`. Default: `GET`.
- `user_agent` (String) User-Agent header of the check.

Optional:

### Nested Schema for `push`

Optional:

- `period_seconds` (Number) Expected ping period in seconds. Default: `interval_seconds`.

### Nested Schema for `ssl`

Required:

Optional:

- `port` (Number) Port. Default: `443`.
- `server_name` (String) SNI name when it differs from host.
- `thresholds_days` (Set of Number) Alert this many days before expiry. Default: the server's thresholds.

- `send` (String) Text to send after connecting.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by monitor id (Settings > Monitors, or GET /api/v1/monitors).
# Secrets are never returned by the API, so the *_wo_version values cannot be imported:
# the first apply after an import sends the configured secrets once.
terraform import rintup_monitor.api 0192f3a4-5b6c-7d8e-9f00-112233445566
```
